{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "brunoerg",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "reported mutation testing gaps, raised DoS concern regarding quadratic minisketch decoding times, noted potential connection overage during v2-v1 downgrade, and noted BIP 330 recon_result parsing"
    },
    {
      "login": "bartoli",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "made generic C++ suggestions on const ref return and vector sizing"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "r:4593554791",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "test coverage gaps in extension handling, boundary conditions, INV relay side effects, and state cleanup leave edge case bugs undetected",
      "quote": "The survivors are mostly about what happens around the edges of the protocol, not the central flow.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author covered relevant mutants in tests",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5285786144",
        "c:5317708143"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5317708143",
      "status_by_quote": "Finished covering the most relevant mutants. Left out the ones regarding extensions, as I'm still debating whether those"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3897009587",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "reconciliation peers could exceed m_max_outbound_full_recon during v2-to-v1 fallback due to a race condition lacking eviction handling",
      "quote": "Could reconcilitation peers exceed `m_max_outbound_full_recon` during v2-to-v1 fallback? Thinking about a possible race.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "outbound reconciliations now have eviction handling",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3903186205",
        "c:5492745419",
        "c:5545629138"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5545629138",
      "status_by_quote": "With this, I should have also covered your concern about v2->v1 downgrades, as outbound reconciliations now have eviction logic."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3897073818",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "malicious peers can trigger expensive minisketch decoding taking 30+ seconds, blocking message processing and causing a DoS",
      "quote": "I got 31.2 seconds on my machine (Ryzen 9 7900). Wondering if a malicious peer could use it to cause a DoS since it would block all msgs processings?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author agreed and suggested limiting sketch size or removing extensions",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3902587961"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3902587961",
      "status_by_quote": "Yes, I think it can. I left a comment on this earlier on the PR."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3897104353",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "non-conformance with BIP 330 by accepting any non-zero byte as true instead of strictly 0 or 1",
      "quote": "nit: I think that, according to the BIP330, we must accept 0 or 1 here. This way it would treat any nonzero byte as true.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "recon_result parsing updated and test added",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3902663460",
        "c:5492745419"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5492745419",
      "status_by_quote": "I changed the way we parse `recon_result` to mimic the check we already have in place for BIP152. Also added a test for it."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4108830198",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "style",
      "text": "return a const reference instead of making a copy",
      "quote": "This could return a const ref  (even though all current calls would make a copy anyway)",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4108896055",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "style",
      "text": "set size once to skdata.size() + m_remote_sketch_snapshot.size() before copying values",
      "quote": "first set size once to skdata.size()+m_remote_sketch_snapshot.size then copy values?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [],
  "notes": "Brought record up to date with the latest rebase comment c:6790923132.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "review of latest changes and rebase",
      "id": "c:6790923132"
    },
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "response to bartoli's suggestions on vector sizing and const ref",
      "id": "rc:4108896055"
    }
  ]
}
